G14 proposals weighed against section 1. Taken: the T3-010|T3-149 question rewritten to name visible words (gates 15, 16). Gates 15 and 16 left five fields of the pair on the old test ('no fight to end', 'ends or forestalls a fight', 'where no fight began'), so the pair's fields contradicted each other, which my stopping criterion forbids; gates 17 to 21 replace those words with the same named words (T3-010 must_show, must_not_show, decide_when_both; T3-149 must_not_show, decide_when_both). T3-149's must_show keeps 'a pact to stop or avoid attacks', read through its list of named forms. Left, with no wording defect I can quote: narrowing T3-010's must_show, a T3-010|T3-011 discriminator, a family decide_when_both. Already met: T3-084|T3-062 (gates 5, 7, 9). Watch items, no source line: T3-149|T3-151 and T3-149|T3-025 still ask whether a fight is ended or forestalled. How I read 'attack named' in these rechecks: attack, war, fight, battle, invasion, raid; a work asked not to be overwritten, destroyed or touched, with none of those words, is a work asked to be spared (T3-010). How a recheck adds a theme the line does not hold: only with three concepts of its own under the new question (the lone-B1 floor's measure), or where it becomes the leading theme; below that its concepts are named in the reason and the line keeps its themes. This threshold rests on QC1-002, still open. Triage packet: out/_analysis/c1_rechecks/gates-15-21-words.md (182 owed items, 105 with concepts to read).
